scope: Curve25519-family miniatures k = 20, 24, 28, 32, five fresh family curves per size, 12 public targets x 8 rounds, C = 2 index-calculus arms on a size-2 prime-projected-abscissa base, ecbench counted GAE with the 2026-11-08 insert pricing at w = 0, 0.1, 1, local route L1; frozen protocol research/curve25519_autolab_20261104/snc-panel/PROTOCOL.md; no signed replay or recompute; classification of tw=2 for the main ledger is the owner's call
statement: SNC-1/SNC-2 shared panel (research/curve25519_autolab_20261104/snc-panel): audits 2160/2160 and 3 x 2700/2700 records with 8 replays reproduced at each size, every record verified. Paired ratios (ecbench compare, 480 pairs, w = 0): lazy certification inc-lazy / inc = 0.9665 [0.966, 0.967] at k = 24, 0.9888 at k = 28, 0.9972 at k = 32, with identical walk and probe counters on every pair; the two-seed chained target walk tw2cj-lazy against the incumbent = 0.936 [0.877, 0.998] at k = 20 (box), and against inc-lazy 0.914 [0.881, 0.948] at k = 24, 0.909 [0.877, 0.942] at k = 28, 0.922 [0.890, 0.955] at k = 32; the order holds at w = 0.1 and 1 for every pre-registered pair. Mean S of tw2cj-lazy at w = 0 is 2.529 / 1.915 / 1.756 / 1.758, ratio to rho-neg 1.61 / 1.63 / 1.74 / 1.78 against the incumbent's 1.72 / 1.84 / 1.94 / 1.93. Stored entries per sqrt(r) of the two-seed walk 1.738 / 1.677 / 1.686 / 1.738, inside the pre-registered [1.66, 1.85]. The 0.75x goal is not approached; the K = 3 collision floor 1.662 bounds this family.
